title: HB 1109 (2025-2026 Regular Session (filed 2026, second year of the session)): Elections; proper identification for presentation to a poll worker; provisions
urls: https://www.legis.ga.gov/legislation/ (detail and vote pages answer 401 without the site token; not used)
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Section 1 (21-2-417(a)(1) and (2)); struck and new words run together in the print
(quote) "(a)(1) Except as provided in subsection (c) of this Code section, each elector shall present proper identification to a poll worker at or prior to completion of a voter's certificate at any polling place and prior to such person's admission to the enclosed space at such polling place. (2) Proper identification required under paragraph (1) of this subsection shall consist: (A) Consist of any one of the following: (1)(i) A Georgia driver's license in a physical format which was properly issued by the Department of Driver Services, except as provided for in subparagraph (B) of this paragraph; (2)(ii) A valid Georgia voter identification card issued under Code Section 21-2-417.1 or other valid identification card issued by a branch, department, agency, or entity of the State of Georgia, any other state, or the United States authorized by law to issue personal identification, provided that such identification card contains a photograph of the elector, except as provided for in subparagraph (B) of this paragraph; (3)(iii) A valid United States passport; (4)(iv) A valid employee identification card containing a photograph of the elector and issued by any branch, department, agency, or entity of the United States government, this state, or any county, municipality, board, authority, or other entity of this state; (5)(v) A valid United States military identification card, provided that such identification card contains a photograph of the elector; or (6)(vi) A valid tribal identification card containing a photograph of the elector; and (B) Not consist of a driver's license or special identification card issued to a noncitizen, including, but not limited to, a driver's license or identification card issued pursuant to Code Section 40-5-21.1."
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Section 1, new subparagraph (B) of 21-2-417(a)(2)
(quote) (B) Not consist of a driver's license or special identification card issued to a noncitizen, including, but not limited to, a driver's license or identification card issued pursuant to Code Section 40-5-21.1."
(section) Section 2, new 40-5-21.1(d) (label and NC prefix on noncitizen licences and ID cards)
(quote) "(d) A temporary license, permit, or special identification card issued pursuant to this Code section on or after August 1, 2027, shall: (1) Include, in a prominent location, the term 'BEARER NOT A U.S. CITIZEN - NOT VOTER ID'; and (2) Have a license, permit, or special identification card number that has been appended with the prefix 'NC' to reflect that such license, permit, or special identification card is held by a noncitizen.
(other) Section 2: temporary licences and ID cards for noncitizens valid only during authorized stay or five years; cards issued before the new rule valid until 31 December 2026; DDS website page explaining the difference (40-5-21.1)
